program:
app "Shopping" bag ink
table purchase what text, amount money, note text?
let spent = sum(purchase.amount month)
setting budget money = 20000 "Monthly budget"
"Safe to spend" round(max(budget - spent, 0) / (monthdays(today) - monthday(today) + 1)) "a day" faint
if(spent > budget, "Over budget by", "Left to spend") abs(budget - spent) big
goal spent, budget, "spent"
form purchase
list purchase month by day
describe:
Shopping, in the ink colours.
Keeps:
- purchase: what: text; amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Monthly budget": money, starts at 20000.
Works out:
- spent is the total amount of purchase this month.
Shows:
- text: "Safe to spend", the larger of budget minus spent and 0 divided by the result of the number of days in the month of today minus the day of the month of today plus 1 rounded, "a day".
- text: "Over budget by" when spent is more than budget, otherwise "Left to spend", budget minus spent without its sign.
- spent out of budget with a progress bar, labelled "spent".
- a form to add a purchase.
- a list of purchase this month by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.

app "Pool" game slate
table point team pick Dad|Son, pts num 1..500 = 1
let a = sum(point.pts where team = Dad)
let b = sum(point.pts where team = Son)
setting winat num = 7 "Play to"
row gap 2
  stack card grow align center
    "Dad" bold

    button "+1" tap add point team = Dad, pts = 1
  stack card grow align center
    "Son" bold

button "Undo" tap remove last(point)
button "New game" tap remove all point

  "Dad win!" head color good

list point

- text: a.

- text: "Son".
- text: b.

- a button "Undo"; a tap removes the latest point entries, with undo.
- a button "New game"; a tap removes all point entries, with one undo.
- text: "Lead:", a minus b without its sign.

program:
app "Times tables" calc mint
table tryx ok bool
state a num = 3
state b num = 4
state ans num = 0
"What is" a "x" b head
field ans "Answer"
button "Check" tap add tryx ok = (ans = a * b) then set a = random(12) then set b = random(12) then set ans = 0
"Right" count(tryx where ok = yes) "of" count(tryx) big
if count(tryx) > 0
  if(last(tryx.ok) = yes, "Correct!", "Not quite") color if(last(tryx.ok) = yes, good, warn)
button "Reset score" tap remove all tryx
describe:
Times tables, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- tryx: ok: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Remembers while you use it: a, starting at 3; b, starting at 4; ans, starting at 0.
Shows:
- text: "What is", a, "x", b.
- a box to fill in ans, labelled "Answer".
- a button "Check"; a tap adds a tryx with ok set to the result of ans is a times b, then sets a to a random whole number from 1 to 12, then sets b to a random whole number from 1 to 12, then sets ans to 0.
- text: "Right", how many tryx entries where ok is yes, "of", how many tryx entries.
- if how many tryx entries is more than 0:
  - text: "Correct!" when the latest ok of tryx is yes, otherwise "Not quite".
- a button "Reset score"; a tap removes all tryx entries, with one undo.

app "Bijli bill" bolt ocean
setting r1 num = 10 "Rate first 100"
setting r2 num = 15 "Rate next 100"
setting r3 num = 25 "Rate above 200"
state units num = 150

describe:

- c1 is the smaller of units and 100 times r1.

program:
app "Pharmacy stock Pro" pill ocean
table med name text, batch text?, qty num 0.., expiry date, alert date
setting alert_days num = 30 "Alert days before expiry"
state n text = ""
state q num = 0
state ex date = today
field n "Medicine"
field q "Quantity"
field ex "Expiry date"
button "Add" tap add med name = n, qty = q, expiry = ex, alert = ex - alert_days then set n = ""
remind "A medicine expires soon" at med.alert
let soon = count(med, it.expiry - today <= alert_days)
soon "items expire within" alert_days "days" head color if(soon > 0, warn, good)
each med where expiry - today <= alert_days sort expiry as m
  row card tap edit m
    m.name bold grow
    m.qty "left"
    if(m.expiry < today, "Expired", "Expires soon") color if(m.expiry < today, bad, warn)
    m.expiry - today "days" faint
list med
describe:
Pharmacy stock Pro, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- med: name: text; batch: text, optional; qty: number, at least 0; expiry: date; alert: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Alert days before expiry": number, starts at 30.
Works out:
- soon is how many of the med have its expiry minus today is at most alert days.
Remembers while you use it: n, starting at ""; q, starting at 0; ex, starting at today.
Shows:
- a box to fill in n, labelled "Medicine".
- a box to fill in q, labelled "Quantity".
- a box to fill in ex, labelled "Expiry date".
- a button "Add"; a tap adds a med with name set to n, qty set to q, expiry set to ex, alert set to ex minus alert days, then sets n to "".
- text: soon, "items expire within", alert days, "days".
- for each med where expiry minus today is at most alert days sorted by expiry:
  - a group; a tap opens the med for editing:
    - text: the name of the med.
    - text: the qty of the med, "left".
    - text: "Expired" when the expiry of the med is less than today, otherwise "Expires soon".
    - text: the expiry of the med minus today, "days".
- a list of med; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
Reminder "A medicine expires soon" on each alert of the med entries.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words
order: mention the last feature first

program:
app "Tea timer" cup slate
table steep
setting length dur = 4m "Steep length"
timer length, "Steep", add steep then notify "Steep done"
count(steep today) "today" head
daybars last 7 days, count(steep on it)
list steep today
describe:
Tea timer, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- steep: just the time of each entry. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Steep length": length of time, starts at 4 minutes.
Shows:
- a countdown timer of length, labelled "Steep"; when it ends it adds a steep, then shows the notice "Steep done".
- text: how many steep entries today, "today".
- a bar chart of how many steep entries on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
- a list of steep today; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: a single sentence of 6 to 12 words, casual
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with the numbers or units

program:
app "Fruit" apple slate
table fruit servings num 1..10 unit "servings", note text?
screen main "Today" home
  stat round(avg(fruit.servings last 30 days)), "average entry, last 30 days"
  quick fruit, servings, [1, 2]
  form fruit
screen past "History" chart
  daybars last 7 days, sum(fruit.servings on it)
  list fruit
describe:
Fruit, in the slate colours.
Keeps:
- fruit: servings: number, 1 to 10, in servings; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a screen "Today":
  - a big number: the average servings of fruit in the last 30 days rounded, labelled "average entry, last 30 days".
  - one-tap buttons that add a fruit with servings set to each of 1, 2.
  - a form to add a fruit.
- a screen "History":
  - a bar chart of the total servings of fruit on that day for each day in the last 7 days.
  - a list of fruit; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
